payload.contentString: Phone call. The patient says that she had a rash after penicillin as a child.
Records copied from Lakeside Family Clinic. The records list a penicillin allergy.
Visit note. Blood pressure is high on two readings. Diagnosis: essential hypertension. Start amlodipine 5 mg daily. Order a lipid panel.
Lipid panel result received. LDL cholesterol is 112 mg/dL.
Visit note. The penicillin skin test and the oral challenge are negative. The patient is not allergic to penicillin.
